name: AK28BH - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR & Electrochemical Sensors, Big-Digit Display
highlights: The AK28B at Full Specification — Same big-digit screen, same four-button front. Infrared NDIR CO₂ and an electrochemical formaldehyde cell make this the top configuration of the AK28 enclosure.
Legible, Operable, Defensible — Three things that usually force a compromise: a screen readable across a room, controls anyone can use without a manual, and sensors whose output survives scrutiny.
Eight Parameters, Three Particulate Fractions — Full laser split with colour-block grouping across the top of the display.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour charge, 246 g, moulded wedge stand.
